title: Deterministic part of a nondeterministic program
statement: Given a nondeterministic register program and a Boolean value $\beta$, its deterministic part assigns each control state its deterministic instruction when the original instruction is deterministic; when it is a choice instruction, it instead assigns the instruction that returns $\beta$ and halts.
hypotheses_covered: A is a nondeterministic register program with m registers and d deciders
